install_virtual_ip_on.description: Interface on which virtual IP addresses are installed. Note that NM also installs the virtual IPs on the XFRM interface.

mtu.description: MTU for XFRM interfaces created by the NM plugin.

port.description: Source port when sending packets to port 500. Defaults to an ephemeral port. May be set to 500 if firewall rules require a static port.

port_nat_t.description: Source port when sending packets to port 4500 or a custom server port. Defaults to an ephemeral port. May be set to e.g. 4500 if firewall rules require a static port.

retransmit_base.description: Base to use for calculating exponential back off, see IKEv2 RETRANSMISSION in strongswan.conf(5). Default retransmission settings for charon-nm are deliberately lower to fail and possibly reestablish SAs more quickly.

retransmit_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds before sending first retransmit.

retransmit_tries.description: Number of times to retransmit a packet before giving up.

routing_table.description: Table where routes via XFRM interface are installed. Should be different than the table used for the regular IKE daemon due to the mark.

routing_table_prio.description: Priority of the routing table. Higher than the default priority used for the regular IKE daemon.

syslog_daemon_level.description: Default logging level for syslog daemon facility.
